title: Your Anger Is a Mask Hiding the Wound You Refuse to Face
description:
Your anger is a mask you wear to hide the wound you refuse to touch. This video dissects the hidden architecture of rage, showing why every outburst is a downstream signal pointing at an unexamined judgment. You will learn the Stoic method to trace heat to its source, name the rule that fuels it, and replace blind reaction with deliberate choice. No platitudes, no soft language -- only the raw mechanics of turning fury into a tool for precision. Apply the three-breath pause, write the triggering thought, and test the underlying rule today. The result is a ledger of examined beliefs that strips the mask away for good. Each repetition rewires the nervous system, turning the automatic flare into a conscious signal you can direct. When the mask falls, the wound becomes visible, and visibility is the only lever that changes the outcome. stoicism, anger, discipline, control, mindset
